title: Advanced Special Topics in Art; Multimodal Print Studio
description:
Students must pay a $40.00 laboratory studio fee.

Course explores various traditional and digital media hybrids while navigating alternative studio-based approaches. Students will be encouraged to use a range of imaging techniques such as photography, drawing, painting, collage and digital media with a focus on experimentation with materials, content and form. Individual and group critiques, readings, online presentations,and exhibitions will help to develop each student's personal approach to art making, problem solving, and visual communication.
